title: Private Cabana Rental on the San Marcos River
includes: All cabanas equipped with a screened-in picnic table and a grill
Cabanas located besides the water for peaceful views
Small (up to 5 guests) or Large (up to 10 guests) Cabanas options available at checkout
Access to the property which includes swings, a slide, badminton court, floating dock, concrete dock
Food & Beverages (you may bring your own) (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: We are private property so you may consume alcohol here. Please do not bring any glass bottles and be aware of the fact that we are next to a park where alcohol consumption is not allowed.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Travelers may select from Small or Large Daily Private Cabana Rentals, depending on the size of your group. Small cabanas seat groups up to 5 travelers, while large cabanas comfortably seat up to 10. All cabanas are located next to the water and are equipped with a screened-in picnic table and new grills. Cabana rentals also provide full access to the property which includes multiple swings, a slide, a sand badminton court, a floating dock, and a concrete dock. Our property is pet-friendly, and we recommend bringing floaties or life jackets for children and everything you need to grill. Travelers may bring in their own food and beverages (but we kindly ask no glass).
